cases.summary: Rapid repeated animation transitions break animation
cases.description:
## Bevy version

current `main` branch (commit 91cd84fea7fa582c5ed029cc3ffe675b1e1bc6c1)

## What you did

Change fox animations too many times too fast in `animated_fox` example.

## What went wrong

The fox stopped animating (despite being supposed to animate forever).

## Draft PR where it's easier to encounter the bug #13909 

Checkout the branch and press Enter many times quickly. (You can use ASDF keys as well)

## Theory

My theory is that transitioning to the same state multiple times breaks the transition code.

Below there are logs for `main_animation` and `transitions` of `AnimationTransitions`.

If you take a look towards the end you will see:
```
Some(NodeIndex(2))
[AnimationTransition { current_weight: 0.0023473431, weight_decline_per_sec: 0.8, animation: NodeIndex(2) }]
Some(NodeIndex(2))
[]
```

As the transition from `NodeIndex(2)` to `NodeIndex(2)` (the same animation) finishes the underlying animation is likely stopped for the transition. However, since the main animation likely reuses the same player it incorrectly stops as well.

As for why it is possible to transition from a state to itself suggests there is a bug in the animation weight decline code.
Since I am using the same animation transition duration and switching between 2 animations, it shouldn't be possible to transition between two of the same animation, unless the transitions decay unevenly. (i.e. transition from `NodeIndex(1)` decays before the transition from `NodeIndex(2)` despite starting later)

evidence.eventual_fix_problem_statement:
Fix repeated animation transition bug

# Objective

Fixes #13910

When a transition is over, the animation is stopped. There was a race condition; if an animation was started while it also had an active transition, the transition ending would then incorrectly stop the newly added animation.

## Solution

When starting an animation, cancel any previous transition for the same animation.

## Testing

The changes were tested manually, mainly by using the `animated_fox` example. I also tested with changes from https://github.com/bevyengine/bevy/pull/13909.

I'd like to have an unit test for this as well, but it seems quite complex to do, as I'm not sure how I would detect an incorrectly paused animation.

Reviewers can follow the instructions in #13910 to reproduce.

Tested on macos 14.4 (M3 processor) Should be platform-independent, though.

commit 93def2611b5c2d4d7e517d1cc8356b36f96328d1
Author: Hannes Karppila <2204863+Dentosal@users.noreply.github.com>
Date:   Mon Jul 22 22:17:46 2024 +0300

    Fix repeated animation transition bug (#14411)
    
    # Objective
    
    Fixes #13910
    
    When a transition is over, the animation is stopped. There was a race
    condition; if an animation was started while it also had an active
    transition, the transition ending would then incorrectly stop the newly
    added animation.
    
    ## Solution
    
    When starting an animation, cancel any previous transition for the same
    animation.
    
    ## Testing
    
    The changes were tested manually, mainly by using the `animated_fox`
    example. I also tested with changes from
    https://github.com/bevyengine/bevy/pull/13909.
    
    I'd like to have an unit test for this as well, but it seems quite
    complex to do, as I'm not sure how I would detect an incorrectly paused
    animation.
    
    Reviewers can follow the instructions in #13910 to reproduce.
    
    Tested on macos 14.4 (M3 processor) Should be platform-independent,
    though.

diff --git a/crates/bevy_animation/src/transition.rs b/crates/bevy_animation/src/transition.rs
index f419f6e9c..77e8fdfef 100644
--- a/crates/bevy_animation/src/transition.rs
+++ b/crates/bevy_animation/src/transition.rs
@@ -92,7 +92,11 @@ impl AnimationTransitions {
             }
         }
 
-        self.main_animation = Some(new_animation);
+        // If already transitioning away from this animation, cancel the transition.
+        // Otherwise the transition ending would incorrectly stop the new animation.
+        self.transitions
+            .retain(|transition| transition.animation != new_animation);
+
         player.start(new_animation)
     }
